author: Yffe
content: Code: (a) vacuity_solver::solver_vacuity_check runs TWO verus harnesses per fn BEFORE L3 (check.rs check_file_with_rlimit) with INVERTED polarity — verus PROVED = reject (vacuous/tautology), FAILED = clean; (b) check.rs equivalence_proves_equal (#101) discharges the survivor-equivalence obligation via run_verus + the #8 cache; (c) strengthen::probe verifies candidate ens via the threaded run_verus closure. None appear in REQ-1/AC-1's class enum (CONTRACT|EXEC|BODY|LOOP_*|OVERFLOW|TERMINATION) nor in the promised 'recorded OUT here' list, and §0's pipeline description ('parse -> validate -> check_effects then per item lower -> run_verus -> assemble_certificate') omits them. Buildability impact on increment (i) #204 ('Verus refactored behind the interface'): these are direct verus consumers that must be scoped in or out, and the vacuity harness polarity shows REQ-3's Proven->certify / Unknown->degrade discipline is WRONG for at least one shipped query class (there, Proven->REJECT, Unknown->proceed). Correction: enumerate the three classes IN (with a polarity/role discriminator on the Obligation) or explicitly OUT of the Engine trait, and bound REQ-3's discipline to certification obligations.
